problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}c \\ d\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the vector $\,x=[\begin{aligned}-6+7\text{i} \\ 1-6\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $ad+bc?$

feedback.problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}c \\ d\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the vector $\,x=[\begin{aligned}-4+9\text{i} \\ 1+8\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $bc-ad?$
feedback.worked_solution:
For the given vector $\,x=[\begin{aligned}-4+9\text{i} \\ 1+8\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =[\begin{aligned}-4+9\text{i} \\ 1+8\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(x)}+\text{i}\,{{[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 8\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(x)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore $\,a=-4,b=1,c=9$ and $d=8$, which implies that 

$$
bc-ad=1\cdot 9-(-4)\cdot 8=41.
$$
